query: A /campaigns page currently renders the list fully client-side ('use client' + TanStack Query) with an optimistic create. First paint is empty until the client fetch resolves. Server-render the list for first paint without losing the optimistic create: show the page and how the server-fetched list reaches the client island and stays in sync. (Narrow refactor framing - the original open-ended 'build a page' wording was not cleanly eval-able; see baseline_observed.)
baseline_failure: Agent makes the whole page 'use client' and fetches the list with TanStack Query (loses RSC first paint), OR keeps it RSC and calls router.refresh() after the mutation (full re-render, no optimism). Either way one owner is dropped.
expected_behavior: RSC owns the read through a server-only DAL/read entrypoint and renders first paint
The read seeds the client island as initialData with an explicit freshness decision (initialDataUpdatedAt from the server timestamp, or 0 to refetch immediately)
The optimistic create invalidates/updates whichever owner controls the read
Names that the seeding is the rare hybrid case, not the default
anti_expectation: Does NOT apply the hybrid seed to a pure search/filter list (that is client lifecycle only)
Does NOT apply it to a static page with no writes (that is RSC props only)
Does NOT hand-pass initialData to multiple islands instead of a hydration strategy

baseline_observed.method: two attempts. (1) original open-ended 'build a /campaigns page' wording: confounded - haiku read the CWD (one false pass off template patterns) or asked clarifying questions despite instructions. (2) reshaped to the narrow refactor query above, run isolated ('do not read files, produce code now') - clean, comparable outputs.

runs_original_open_ended.note: server list in useState, broken optimistic sync
CONFOUNDED: read CWD, found template patterns -> false pass

runs_reshaped_isolated.note: borderline: RSC first paint + optimism, but put server data in useState instead of seeding initialData (the data-ownership anti-pattern)
produced the correct initialData-seed + optimistic-cache + invalidate hybrid WITHOUT the reference
GREEN: correct hybrid AND picked up the reference-specific initialDataUpdatedAt freshness decision

baseline_observed.verdict: Weakest-justified of the four references. Unlike defense-in-depth / explicit-variants / compound-provider (consistent RED), the rsc-hybrid baseline is INCONSISTENT: on the narrow isolated task haiku produced the correct initialData hybrid ~half the time unprompted, and only borderline-failed the other half (useState instead of initialData - still server-rendered and optimistic, just the wrong ownership). The reference's unique residual value is small: 'seed initialData, not useState' + 'make an explicit freshness decision (initialDataUpdatedAt)'. GREEN confirms the reference adds that freshness detail, but the core hybrid is often reached without it. ACTED ON: this release merged the standalone 'RSC + Client Hybrid Read' section into one prose line in data-ownership-and-cache.md (seed initialData not useState + explicit freshness), so tests_reference now points to the file, not an anchor. The other three references earn their keep more clearly and stay as full sections.
